description: Thermal blind controller: operational state, room heat models, solar budgets, blind positions and debugging. 100=open, 0=closed.

options.content:
**100% = fully open · 0% = fully closed**   |   [ioBroker objects](https://192.168.178.40:8081/#tab-objects/select/thermalblindcontrol.0)

Overview gauges show all blinds. **Room** filters room models; **Blind** filters detailed blind charts. In **SHADOW / DRY_RUN**, planned positions can differ from actual positions. Energy and predicted peaks are **rolling 24-hour forecasts recorded at each evaluation**, not measured energy totals. New diagnostic history starts on 15 October 2026; existing sensor history remains available.
